overview_description.description: Box is an online file sharing and cloud content management service offering unlimited storage, custom branding, and administrative controls. Box provides more than 8 million users with secure cloud content management and collaboration. Box platform "allows personal and commercial content to be accessible, sharable, and storable in any format from anywhere." It also helps businesses of all sizes in every industry securely access and manages their critical information in the cloud.

about_short_description.short_description: Box is an online file sharing and cloud content management service offering unlimited storage, custom branding, and administrative controls.

product.name: Box Intelligent Content Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for storing, organizing, managing, sharing, and governing enterprise content with collaboration, workflow, security, and AI capabilities.

product.name: Box Collaboration
product.description: Tools for securely sharing, reviewing, editing, and co-creating files with internal and external users across web, desktop, and mobile environments.

product.name: Box AI
product.description: AI capabilities embedded in Box for summarizing, analyzing, searching, extracting information from, and generating content based on authorized enterprise files.

product.name: Box Automate
product.description: A no-code workflow automation platform that combines document processing, AI agents, routing, approvals, and Box-native actions for business processes.

product.name: Box Security and Compliance
product.description: Enterprise controls for protecting content through access management, threat detection, classification, encryption, governance, retention, and compliance management.

product.name: Box Extract
product.description: An AI-powered document processing service that extracts structured data and metadata from contracts, forms, statements, images, and other unstructured files.
